about: Golden reads of the sample handwritten scripts, for the offline mock only. The mock recognises a page by the SHA-256 of its bytes and returns these reads: the first entry on the first read, the last entry on a re-read. A live model reads the images themselves and never sees this file.

reads.name: Ruan Botha
reads.text:
Is technology good for us?

Some people say technology is ruining young people, but I
believe it has done more good than harm for young South
Africans, as long as we use it the right way.

Firstly, technology helps us with school. When I was sick for
a week I watched the lessons on YouTube and I did not fall
behind. My cousin in Upington uses a free app to practise
maths every night because there is no tutor in his town.

Secondly, technology gives young people a chance to earn
money. My brother sells car parts on Facebook Marketplace
and he saves for his studies. Many young people find jobs
and bursaries online that they would never hear about
otherwise.

reads.name: Ruan Botha
reads.text:
However, there is also harm. Some learners are on their
phones until two in the morning and then they fall asleep in
class. Cyberbullying is a real problem and it can make people
feel worthless.

In conclusion, technology is like a tool. It can hurt you if you
use it wrong, but it has given my generation more
opportunities than any generation before us.

reads.name: Sipho Ndlovo
reads.text:
Technology good or bad

Technology is good for young people in south africa. i
think it has done more good then harm. we use phones
every day and it help us alot.

First, you can learn on the internet. when i dont
understand in class i watch a video and then i
understand it better. also we can do research for
projects fast.

Second you can talk to your family who is far. my uncle
work in Cape Town and we whatsapp him every week.

reads.name: Bongani Sithole
reads.text:
Technology

Technology has done more harm than good i think.
Becuase young people dont go outside anymore and
they just sit with phones. Also they dont respect
elders because of what they see on the internet.

There is good things like you can google your
homework and you can watch soccer highlights. And
you can apply for jobs.
